title: Bit Shift
text: Logical or arithmetic shift of input signal, 1 input, 1 output, {Shift Mode} sets Type and direction of shift Shift Left; {Shift Length} sets the number of bits to be shifted. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Shift Mode
params.values: Type and direction of shift Shift Left Logical (default) | Shift Right Logical | Shift Right Arithmetic

params.name: Shift Length
params.values: Number of bits to be shifted 0 (default)
